rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Direxion Daily S&P Oil & Gas E&P Bull 2X Shares
positions.sector: Energy — Oil & Gas Exploration & Production (2x Leveraged ETF)
positions.catalyst: Crude is spiking for a FIFTH straight session on a hard, escalating geopolitical supply shock: WTI broke $90 (+~3.8%, highest since June 8) and Brent neared $100 (+~4.6%, highest since late May) after reported attacks on tankers off Saudi Arabia and renewed US threats to escalate strikes on Iran, putting the Strait of Hormuz and Bab-el-Mandeb transit routes at risk. Brent is on track for a ~35% monthly gain — a third-largest monthly move in a decade. Crucially this catalyst is UNCORRELATED to today's risk-off tech tape: GOOGL (-~5% despite a revenue/cloud beat, sinking on a $195-205B capex hike) and TSLA (-~6.6% on its worst revenue drop in a decade) are both gapping down, and INTC reports tonight — energy sidesteps all of it and tends to catch a bid on exactly the geopolitical risk-off that hurts leveraged tech.
positions.driver: Long 2x oil & gas E&P (GUSH) as a momentum + supply-shock play with an asymmetric one-sided catalyst, deliberately chosen OVER the earnings binaries. Skipped shorting TSLA — TSLZ (2x inverse) had already gapped +13.5% premarket (chase risk, >8-10% rule) and Tesla is prone to intraday reversals. Skipped buying the GOOGL dip — catching a falling 2x knife (GGLL -10%) into a risk-off tape has no downside protection. Chose GUSH (E&P producers, higher crude-beta) over ERX (integrated majors) for more torque per barrel move, and it was LESS extended (+3.4% vs ERX +4.1%). Entered UNEXTENDED at ~+3.4% (41.30 vs 39.96 close) — not chasing a blown-out gap. 2x (not 3x) matches high conviction on continuation of a strong 5-day trend with a live catalyst, not a single explosive binary. Hard stop 38.00 (-8% on 2x).
positions.risks: A sudden Middle East de-escalation — an Iran truce, or the tanker attacks proving minor/contained — could unwind the crude bid fast on an overnight headline, and 2x amplifies both directions; leveraged energy ETFs also carry daily-reset decay if crude chops sideways. Oil is somewhat extended after a 5-session run, raising pullback risk. A broad risk-off cascade from tech earnings could drag even energy in a de-grossing. Hard stop 38.00 (-8%).
